periods.label: Week of August 10, 2026
periods.summaryTitle: Quality of Life & Character Customization Update

features: Characters now preserve build details across multiple characters while sharing account currencies and equipment.
New players benefit from updated defaults, including automatic item and spell equipping when creating a new character.
The Leaderboard system now ranks heroes based on their accumulated Souls score for earning Death Echoes.

Gameplay has received significant additions, such as dedicated Realm Challenges allowing two-player PvP combat (with winner resource gains), and the introduction of Bonk actions in competitive realms.
Controls have been expanded to support DualShock controllers with mapping for all spell slots and camera-relative movement.
The Devlog feature now includes explanations on community voting workflows and how development is driven by autonomous AI agents.
Mobile gameplay has improved responsiveness, ensuring key options remain accessible across safe areas and providing touch input feedback (preview/hold).

commits.title: balance(combat): revise status and blocking rules
commits.description:
- scale Voodoo poison amplification from 1x at level 1 to 2x at level 99

- make Poison, Bleed, and Burn ticks bypass dodge and block

- remove Blocking's reactive cooldown and allow consecutive block rolls

- guarantee Penance restores at least 1% of maximum Mana per successful block

- cap buckler, Katar, and Reflective Surge block chance at 90%

- synchronize combat projections, tooltips, specs, and boundary tests
